Here at easyHotel, we are now looking to recruit a fantastic Full-Time Receptionist to join the team at our easyHotel The Hague City Centre/Scheveningen Beach.

About easyHotel

Our mission is to make travel more affordable with smartly designed hotels that give guests just what they need for a great night's sleep.  That means hotels that are easy to book, easy to use, and in central or well-connected locations with four-star style beds too.

We keep things simple, so guests can focus on enjoying the destination or getting on with their work.  Whether they're travelling on a budget or just prefer to spend more on the experiences that matter, we're here for them.

As part of the easy family of brands, we're known for delivering great value and service. It's what sets us apart and what keeps our guests coming back.

For that mission, we can use a new colleague. We are looking for a receptionist who is willing to work all types of shifts, early & late – also in weekends. Apart from the regular reception activities, you are jointly responsible for the entire hotel. 

About you

You have a passion for hospitality, act with integrity, and bring strong common sense. You shine in welcoming and assisting guests, contributing to a warm atmosphere and a positive guest experience. You speak fluent English and/or Dutch, and have at least one year of front-office experience—or a strong motivation to grow in this role.
